Application Data.NAME: CableNet Communications Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CableNet Communications Inc. specializes in providing high-speed internet, cable television, and telecommunication services to residential and commercial customers. Our operations include the installation, maintenance, and support of cable and network infrastructure, as well as customer service and technical assistance. We prioritize quality service delivery and adhere to industry standards to ensure customer satisfaction.
Application Data.GENERAL INFO QUESTIONS:

2. **No.** The business does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its marketing or community engagement efforts.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a severe storm caused damage to several cable service installations, resulting in an estimated loss of $2,500. The affected equipment was repaired and back in service by March 25, 2023. The claim has been closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class II, Grade B, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site 24/7, perimeter fencing installed, and access control systems in place.
